code: local out={} for _,m in ipairs(game:GetService("LogService"):GetLogHistory()) do if m.messageType==Enum.MessageType.MessageError or m.messageType==Enum.MessageType.MessageWarning then out[#out+1]=string.sub(m.message,1,160) end end local c={} for _,l in ipairs(out) do c[l]=(c[l] or 0)+1 end local r={} for l,n in pairs(c) do r[#r+1]=n.."x "..l end table.sort(r) return "CONSOLE "..#out.."|"..table.concat(r,"\n")
